text:
Priya Nair: Customer sent a security questionnaire (SOC2 + ISO) asking a few one-off items: logs (retention + redaction), subprocessors + encryption at rest, and support access approval flow. Need a concise answer I can send by EOD. Any quick pointers?

Tom Becker: FAQ -> https://internal.redwood/sec/qna ; short answers: debug logs retained 90d, audit logs 365d. Redaction pipeline applies before long-term storage. Audit logs are immutable snapshots. cc @Alice Kim for redaction specifics. :+1:

Alice Kim: Short customer-friendly phrasing: "We redact PII (emails, SSNs, payment data) via deterministic hashing and tokenization before storage; logs are encrypted at rest with KMS-managed keys; audit logs retained 365 days." Sharing a tiny snippet of the scrub rules we use (handy to paste):

```
# redaction rules (excerpt)
match "email" => replace("[REDACTED_EMAIL]")
regex /\b\d{3}-\d{2}-\d{4}\b/ => replace("[REDACTED_SSN]")
match "credit_card" => replace("[REDACTED_CC]")
```

Javier Cruz: For subprocessors, point them to the vendor inventory we publish (internal link) and note we provide an exported list on request. Compliance team owns the canonical list: https://internal.redwood/compliance/subprocs. @infra-bot can we confirm no new subproc added since Jan 2026?

infra-bot: Ticket created: #1234 (access-approval-check) assigned to Tom Becker.

Tom Becker: Access approvals summary you can paste: "Production access requires manager approval + security approver sign-off; requests use the IAM request template and are time-limited (default 4 hours for support sessions). All access is logged and reviewed." Example CLI template: `iam-request --user bob --roles support_read --duration 4h --justification \"customer debug\"`.

Priya Nair: Perfect. Can someone assemble a 3-4 bullet response I can paste into the questionnaire? I want minimal wording + links to internal artifacts.

Alice Kim: Draft pushed to drive: https://drive.redwood/answers/soc2-2026 — bullets I used: 
- Data encrypted in transit and at rest (KMS-managed keys).
- PII redacted via a pre-storage scrub pipeline (examples + rules available).
- Audit logs retained 365 days; debug logs 90 days.
- Subprocessors roster available on request; canonical list maintained by Compliance.
- Prod access requires manager + security approval; time-bound sessions.

Javier Cruz: LGTM. + add that we perform quarterly pentests and have an annual SOC2 renewal cadence.

Priya Nair: Added the pentest/SOC2 note and sent the reply to the customer. Thanks all :pray: If Compliance needs tweaks, ping me and I'll follow up.
